note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 65 homes for sale in Greece, each one checked by a person.
In Greece, the median asking price of those 65 homes is €130,000 (€1,400 per m², from the 64 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €68,000 and the most expensive €210,000.
Taxes and fees add about 5.5–7% to the price of a home in Greece (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer tax 3.09% of the price or the taxable value, whichever is higher; notary about 0.8-1% plus VAT; land registry fees about 0.5-0.7%; lawyer 1-2% plus VAT; if an agent is used, the buyer usually pays a commission of 1-3% plus VAT on top.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. Buyers from outside the EU and EFTA need a permit to buy in designated border areas (parts of northern Greece and eastern Aegean islands such as the Dodecanese and Rhodes). The government has announced a 15% transfer tax for non-EU buyers of homes from 1 January 2027, not yet final in September 2026.
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners on 1 January pay the unified property tax (ENFIA), calculated per property from its location, size, age and official zone value, with an extra charge if total Greek property exceeds €500,000.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents pay Greek tax on Greek rental income at 15% up to €12,000, 25% to €24,000, 35% to €36,000 and 45% above, after a flat 5% deduction for expenses.

homes.title: House in good condition with terrace, garden and parquet floors in Sperchogeia, Messenia
homes.title_es: Casa en buen estado con terraza, jardín y suelos de parquet en Sperchogeia, Mesenia
homes.summary: This ground-floor house is in good condition, with a sound structure and exterior. It has 200 square metres of living space, 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a sitting room and a living room with wood parquet floors. Outdoor features include a terrace, a garden, a plot of 500 square metres, a west orientation and a view of the square. The sea is 4000 metres away and the airport is 5000 metres away. Wooden window frames complete the property. Asking €85,000, about €425/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with mountain views and roof terrace in Katsidoni, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con vistas a la montaña y azotea en Katsidoni, Creta
homes.summary: This renovated house is fully furnished and spread over two levels. The ground floor has an open plan living area with kitchen, a bathroom and a bedroom, and the second floor has a living area and two bedrooms. Outside there is a roof terrace with views, a courtyard of about 15 m2 and a plot of 70 m2. The home has solar panels and a TV antenna, and it is 12 km from the sea, with village views. Asking €85,000, about €885/m².

homes.title: Three-bedroom village house with a vine-covered terrace and sea views in Messinia
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de tres dormitorios con terraza de parra y vistas al mar en Mesenia
homes.summary: A 116 m² two-storey house in Vasilitsi, at the southern tip of the Messinian peninsula, with views over the sea and the hills: three bedrooms, two kitchens, two living rooms and two bathrooms, a covered veranda and a vine-shaded terrace with blue railings, plus a roof terrace with views of the sea and mountains. Air conditioning, double glazing and wooden floors. Memi and Ammoudi beaches are about 3 km away. Asking €109,000, about €940/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom detached house with garden and fireplace in Mikropoli, Drama
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 3 dormitorios totalmente reformada con jardín y chimenea en Mikropoli, Drama
homes.summary: This fully renovated detached house dates from before 1955 and is arranged over two levels connected by an internal staircase. It has three bedrooms with wardrobes, two living rooms, a fitted kitchen with electrical appliances, and one bathroom. Outdoor and extra features include a large garden, a fireplace, a storage room, and an 830 sq.m. plot. The property has independent oil-fired heating. It is available immediately. Asking €80,000, about €541/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house with sea views and terrace in Agios Stefanos, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios con vistas al mar y terraza en Agios Stefanos, Creta
homes.summary: This house spreads over three levels and offers 130 m2 of living area in Agios Stefanos, Crete. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a separate toilet, a kitchen, a dining room, a small living room with a fireplace and a store room. The second-floor living room can be turned into a bedroom with an en suite bathroom. Outdoors, there is a big balcony and a big terrace, both with sea views, and a plot of 145 m2 that can become a garden with a BBQ area. Asking €92,000, about €708/m².

homes.title: In good condition 3-bedroom maisonette with mountain views and fireplace in Archanes, Crete
homes.title_es: Dúplex de 3 dormitorios en buen estado con vistas a la montaña y chimenea en Archanes, Creta
homes.summary: This ground-floor maisonette is in good condition. It has 3 bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and 1 bathroom, with mosaic and wood floors. A fireplace, cupboards and a 65 sq m storage unit are included, and the land measures 2,056 sq ft. The home has mountain views, and the building dates from 1960. The sea is 10 km away, the city centre is 10 km away, the nearest village is 10 m away, and the airport is 10 km away. Asking €130,000, about €684/m².

homes.title: Whitewashed Cretan village house with a roof terrace and spiral stairs
homes.title_es: Casa encalada en un pueblo de Creta con azotea y escalera de caracol
homes.summary: A renovated 93 m² detached house in the traditional village of Choumeriako, 3 km from Neapoli and 13 km from the beaches of Agios Nikolaos. Downstairs, a modern kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom with a corner bath; a spiral staircase leads up to a lovely sitting room with a wood stove that opens onto a big terrace with umbrellas and views over the village. Stone arches, wooden beams and whitewashed walls keep its old character. Asking €115,000, about €1,237/m².

homes.title: Detached 3-bedroom house in good condition with annex and garden in Kato Chorio, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 3 dormitorios en buen estado con anexo y jardín en Kato Chorio, Creta
homes.summary: This detached house is in good condition, with a main house and a self-contained annex on one level. It has 2 double bedrooms in the main house, a double bedroom in the annex, a kitchen/breakfast room, and a fireplace in the annex living room. The approximately 850 m2 garden plot has mature trees, a vegetable plot, 2 storage rooms and possible off-road parking. Water and electricity are connected, drainage is to a septic tank, and the sea is within a 15 minute drive. Asking €145,000, about €967/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house with terrace and views in Sinarades, Corfu
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios con terraza y vistas en Sinarades, Corfú
homes.summary: The house has three levels with 125 m2 of living space, two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and one bathroom. Both bedrooms are bright, and one opens onto its own balcony above the entrance terrace. The home keeps its original wooden features and has a ground floor cellar, plus a small yard shared with the neighbouring property. Views reach over village rooftops and greenery, and the beaches of Agios Gordios and Kontogialos are close by, with Corfu Town within easy reach. Asking €150,000, about €1,200/m².

homes.title: Renovated former olive mill house with terrace and fireplace in Kalamitsi Alexandrou, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa renovada, antiguo molino de aceite con terraza y chimenea en Kalamitsi Alexandrou, Creta
homes.summary: Renovated traditional former olive oil mill with 154 m² of built area, 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The building is in good structural condition and has an open plan equipped kitchen, a fireplace, wood heating and a terrace. It sits on a 172 m² plot in the village of Kalamitsi Alexandrou, with shared parking next to the house. A central wall divides it into two independent homes, which can also be combined into one. Asking €160,000, about €1,039/m².

homes.title: Two-level stone house with a sea view in Marathokampos, Samos
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de dos plantas con vistas al mar en Marathokampos, Samos
homes.summary: A well-kept 80 m² stone house in the upper part of Marathokampos, in the Agia Triada area, with a wonderful view of the sea. On the ground floor a kitchen, a dining room and a bathroom; upstairs two bedrooms, a living room, a hall and a WC. Wooden window frames, parquet and tiled floors and a wood boiler for heating. A traditional house in a picturesque spot, ready to live in. Asking €68,000, about €850/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house with garden and courtyard in Stavrochori, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios con jardín y patio en Stavrochori, Creta
homes.summary: This house in Stavrochori, South East Crete, has an open plan living area with kitchen. It has two bedrooms and one bathroom, with about 100 m2 of living space. The plot covers approximately 200 m2 and includes a garden and courtyard of about 100 m2. The house is 7 km from the sea and 7 km from Makry Gialos and all amenities. Asking €85,000, about €850/m².

homes.title: Traditional stone house with sea views and fireplace in Achladia, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional de piedra con vistas al mar y chimenea en Achladia, Creta
homes.summary: This is a traditional stone house in Achladia, with a living area of about 95 m2. It has three bedrooms, one of which has a separate entrance, and one bathroom. The living area has a fireplace, and a courtyard leads to a roof terrace with views of the sea and mountains. The house stands on a plot of 114 m2. Solar panels and central heating are fitted, the sea is 8 km away, and all services are connected. Asking €86,000, about €905/m².

homes.title: Traditional 3-bedroom two-storey house with sea views in Tourloti, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional de 3 dormitorios de dos plantas con vistas al mar en Tourloti, Creta
homes.summary: This traditional two-storey house stands about 3 km from the sea in Tourloti, East Crete. The ground floor, about 56 m2, has a kitchen-living area, a bedroom and an outdoor bathroom. The first floor, about 33 m2, has two large bedrooms and a balcony with sea views. The property also has village and mountain views and 700 sq ft of land. All services are connected and access is good. Asking €87,000, about €978/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom two-level house with garden and separate entrances in Akoumia, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 2 dormitorios de dos plantas con jardín y entradas independientes en Akoumia, Creta
homes.summary: This renovated two-level house in the village of Akoumia has two separate entrances, giving each floor its own access. The ground floor has one bedroom, a bathroom and a kitchen, while the first floor has two bedrooms, a kitchen and a bathroom. A private garden and a balcony add outdoor space for dining and relaxing. The village is 39 km from Rethymno. It is located near the village central square. Asking €105,000, about €897/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready furnished house with terrace and fireplace in Komnina, Phthiotis, Central Greece
homes.title_es: Casa amueblada lista para entrar a vivir con terraza y chimenea en Komnina, Phthiotis, Grecia Central
homes.summary: Move-in ready detached house, built in 1987 and sold fully furnished with all electrical appliances. It has one bathroom, an open-plan living room and kitchen, built-in wardrobes and tiled floors. Outdoor and extra features include a terrace, a parking space, an 800 sq.m. plot, a 15 sq.m. external storage room and a fireplace. Oil heating and air conditioning are fitted. Kamena Vourla beach is about 10 km away, Thermopylae hot springs about 20 km, and Athens International Airport about 205 km. Asking €120,000, about €1,132/m².

homes.title: Four-bedroom village house with a sea-view roof terrace in Othos, Karpathos
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de cuatro dormitorios con terraza con vistas al mar en Othos, Karpathos
homes.summary: A three-floor house of 165 m² in Othos, the highest village on Karpathos, renovated in 2014. Four bedrooms and four bathrooms, a large separate kitchen with a breakfast bar and a bright tiled living room. The top floor opens onto a wide terrace that looks over the white village, the hills and the Aegean. It is connected to mains water and sewage, and the village centre is a walk away. The advert puts Pigadia, the island capital and ferry port, 12 km away and Sikelao beach 8 km away. Asking €170,000, about €1,030/m², low for an island house this size.

homes.title: Renovated detached stone house with courtyard in Andriani, Messinia
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra adosada renovada con patio en Andriani, Mesinia
homes.summary: A detached stone house of 148 m2 in the village of Andriani, freshly renovated and set on a plot of about 500 m2. The photos show new timber floors, new wooden windows and doors, a fitted white kitchen and modern tiled bathrooms. Downstairs is a large living and dining area with a bathroom, and upstairs two big bedrooms, two more bathrooms and a balcony with country views. Two entrances, one onto a paved courtyard and garden by the kitchen, the other onto private parking. The seaside village of Agios Andreas is 7 km away and Kalamata about 50 km. Agency fee is extra.

homes.title: Traditional corner house in Agiasos, Lesbos' mountain village
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional de esquina en Agiasos, el pueblo de montaña de Lesbos
homes.summary: A traditional corner residence with two bedrooms in Agiasos, at about 460 m on the green slopes of Mount Olympus on Lesbos, a village known for pottery and woodcarving. Freshly painted facade with balcony, stone and wood details inside, and the island's beaches and olive groves around it.

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a Libyan Sea view in Agios Vasileios, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada con vistas al mar de Libia en Agios Vasileios, Creta
homes.summary: A 61 m² stone house in the village of Agios Vasileios (Viannos), renovated in 2010, with a sweeping view over olive groves to the Libyan Sea from its terraces. An open living room and kitchen under wooden beams, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a small storeroom in the yard, on a 148 m² plot with parking outside. Sold furnished. Energy rating D. Asking €76,000, about €1,246/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a sea view in Marathokampos, Samos
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada con vistas al mar en Marathokampos, Samos
homes.summary: A renovated two-storey stone house in the Profitis Ilias quarter of Marathokampos, high above the bay, with a wide sea view from the balcony and windows. Downstairs a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom open onto a small courtyard; upstairs two bright bedrooms. Double glazing and air conditioning; sold furnished and with appliances, ready to move into. Energy rating F. Asking €80,000, about €1,250/m².

homes.title: Fairy-tale house with a gazebo and stone BBQ in the Pelion forest
homes.title_es: Casa de cuento con cenador y barbacoa de piedra en el bosque de Pelion
homes.summary: Surrounded by towering trees in the mountain village of Chania in Pelion, a 68 m² single-family house renovated in 2021 on a 213 m² corner plot: a wood-lined living room with a fireplace, a bedroom with its own fireplace, a modern kitchen, a bathroom and a small veranda, plus a 29 m² basement, two storerooms, a built-in stone BBQ and a large covered gazebo in a green garden. Sold with furniture and three inverter air conditioners. Asking €95,000, about €1,397/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with garden and views in Vrises, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 2 dormitorios con jardín y vistas en Vrises, Creta
homes.summary: This renovated house sits on two levels in the mountain village of Vrises. The upper level has an open plan living room, dining area and fitted kitchen with balcony access, two double bedrooms and a bathroom. The lower level has two storage rooms. The property has a private garden with mature trees, views, central heating and solar water heating. The plot is approx 350m2, Neapolis is a 5 minute drive away and Heraklion airport is within a one hour drive. Asking €115,000, about €1,278/m².

homes.title: Two-storey 3-bedroom house with sea views near the beach in Varnavas, East Attica
homes.title_es: Casa de dos plantas de 3 dormitorios con vistas al mar cerca de la playa en Varnavas, Ática Oriental
homes.summary: This two-storey maisonette was built in 1995 and sits in a quiet location suitable for families all year round. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a kitchen and a living room across two levels, with tiled floors. Features include sea views, aluminium frames with double glazing, awnings and surrounding space included in the ownership. The beach is 5 minutes away and Athens is 50 km distant. Asking €120,000, about €1,000/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom detached house with fireplace and land in Kainourgio, Phthiotis
homes.title_es: Casa unifamiliar renovada de 3 dormitorios con chimenea y terreno en Kainourgio, Phthiotis
homes.summary: This renovated detached house is move-in ready, with the structure in good condition. It has three bedrooms, an open-plan living room and kitchen, and one bathroom. Features include a fireplace, a plot of about 300 sq.m., an open parking space and an independent 20 sq.m. storage room. The home has individual oil heating and four air-conditioning units. The beach is about 2.3 km away, the E75 motorway about 3 km and Nea Anchialos Airport about 114 km. Asking €130,000, about €1,161/m².

homes.title: Stone house with sea views and private courtyard in Ano Manna, Syros
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra con vistas al mar y patio privado en Ano Manna, Syros
homes.summary: This 85 m² stone-built detached house is in good condition and retains its traditional character. It has a living room, kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom, plus a semi-outdoor covered area, an external WC, a storage room and a water cistern. The private courtyard has space for outdoor seating and dining, and the house has sea views. Oil-fired central heating with radiators, double glazing and mains sewerage are included, and the property sits on a 151 m² plot with road frontage near local schools. Asking €130,000, about €1,529/m².

homes.title: Traditional stone 3-bedroom villa with studio and views in Exo Apidi, Crete
homes.title_es: Villa de piedra tradicional de 3 dormitorios con estudio y vistas en Exo Apidi, Creta
homes.summary: This is a traditional stone villa in Exo Apidi, Crete. The main villa has an open plan living area with kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a studio with its own separate entrance and a bathroom. The home includes courtyards at the front and rear, views of the village and mountains, and a plot of 308 m2. It has air conditioning and all services connected, with the sea 8 km away. Asking €150,000, about €1,154/m².

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with garden and sea views in Eretria, Euboea
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios renovada con jardín y vistas al mar en Eretria, Eubea
homes.summary: Built in 2008 and renovated in 2010, this ground-floor home offers 110 m2 with 2 bedrooms, an open-plan kitchen and living room, a bathroom and a WC. The garden, a terrace and 30 sq m of balconies, along with sea views, add outdoor space. The 500 sq m plot includes a fireplace, air conditioning and a 15 sq m storage unit. The sea is 1000 metres away and the town centre 1500 metres away. The building has an A+ energy rating. Asking €178,000, about €1,618/m².

homes.title: Renovated single-storey country house among olive groves near Gytheio
homes.title_es: Casa de campo unifamiliar renovada entre olivos cerca de Gytheio
homes.summary: A single-storey house of 82 m2 on an 845 m2 hillside plot with 17 olive trees, a citrus tree and a vine pergola, recently renovated: new floor tiles inside and out, new kitchen cupboards, restored timber roof, shutters and doors, fresh paint. Living room, kitchen with WC, two bedrooms, an extra room for dining or office, and a bathroom with bath. Two covered terraces look over the olive groves. Air conditioning in three rooms, mains water and electricity, septic tank. Sold largely furnished. Only three other houses nearby, so it is very quiet and you will need a car.

homes.title: Furnished traditional detached house with garden and views in Drosopigi, Laconia
homes.title_es: Casa independiente tradicional amueblada con jardín y vistas en Drosopigi, Laconia
homes.summary: The traditional-style house is in very good condition and sold fully furnished. It offers 63 sq m with one bedroom, a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and a 5 sq m storage room. Outdoors there is a private garden, a 15 sq m covered veranda and a parking space, with beautiful scenic views. The home has air conditioning and there is scope to extend it. A beach is 8 km away, Areopoli 11 km and Gytheio 22 km. Asking €90,000, about €1,429/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house with garden, fireplace and land in Perivolakia, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios con jardín, chimenea y terreno en Perivolakia, Creta
homes.summary: This house with a garden in Perivolakia sits about 12 km from the beach. It has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a living room with a fireplace and air conditioning, a kitchen, a laundry room and a guest WC. A covered veranda of about 15 m2 is at the entrance. The 288 m2 plot has a well maintained garden with automatic irrigation and fruit trees such as oranges, lemons, figs and olives. The home has a solar water heater and a peaceful setting within easy reach of the coast. Asking €105,000, about €1,400/m².

homes.title: Country house in good condition with olive garden and fireplace in Dimitropoulo, Achaea
homes.title_es: Casa de campo en buen estado con jardín de olivos y chimenea en Dimitropoulo, Acaya
homes.summary: This two-level country house, built in 1980, is in good condition and sits on a 1,200 sq m plot of land. The ground floor has a large living room with a fireplace, a kitchen and a bathroom, and the first floor has a bedroom with WC. Outside there is a garden with 16 olive trees and a terrace. The living room has an air conditioner, and the home is in Dimitropoulo, Aigialia, Achaea. Asking €120,000, about €1,237/m².

homes.title: Move-in ready stone house with garden and fireplace in Armeni, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra lista para entrar a vivir con jardín y chimenea en Armeni, Creta
homes.summary: This move-in ready stone house is furnished and decorated to a high standard, with a modern feel and traditional touches. It has two double bedrooms, one bathroom, an open plan living and dining area with a wood burner, and a fully fitted kitchen with a large open fireplace. Outdoor features include a shaded front terrace, a well established garden, a 606 sqm plot with fruit trees, and parking at the entrance. The home has electric water heating. Armeni lies roughly 27 km southwest of Sitia town. Asking €145,000, about €1,381/m².

homes.title: Furnished Cretan house with a shared pool for just four homes
homes.title_es: Casa amueblada en Creta con piscina compartida entre solo cuatro casas
homes.summary: Villa Dionysos: a fully furnished 76 m² two-bedroom house over two floors in a small, quiet complex in Drapanos, near Chania. A bright open-plan living room with a corner sofa and fireplace opens onto a covered private terrace; the kitchen and dining area look out over the pool, shared by only four houses and backed by open countryside. Upstairs, two double bedrooms, each with its own terrace, the master with sea views. Asking €158,000, about €2,079/m².

homes.title: Renovated 1-bedroom house with terrace and views in Prina, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 1 dormitorio con terraza y vistas en Prina, Creta
homes.summary: Renovated old house with wooden windows, doors and ceiling beams in its original style, sold furnished. Two levels with a living room, a shower room and a separate kitchen with a corner fireplace. The double bedroom opens onto a private terrace with village and mountain views. Water and electricity are connected, and solar water heating is fitted. Kalo Horio and the Istron beaches are 5 to 10 minutes away by car, and Heraklion airport is within 90 minutes. Asking €110,000, about €1,833/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with fireplace and terrace in Voulismeni, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada con chimenea y terraza en Voulismeni, Creta
homes.summary: This old stone house was renovated in 2009 and keeps its exposed stonework, wooden beams and internal stone arch. It has one double-sized bedroom, one bathroom, a living room with fireplace and a fitted kitchen and dining area across about 75 m2. A private gated courtyard leads to a first-floor terrace reached from the bedroom. Neapolis is 2 km away, Agios Nikolaos and beaches are within 15 km, and Heraklion airport is a 40-minute drive. Asking €135,000, about €1,800/m².

homes.title: Stone cottage in good condition with garden and fireplace in Limenaria, Thasos
homes.title_es: Casita de piedra en buen estado con jardín y chimenea en Limenaria, Thasos
homes.summary: This stone cottage is in good condition and suited to year round living. It has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and an attic loft converted into a third bedroom, plus a separate kitchen and a sunroom. Outdoor features include a garden, a terrace, a cellar, a fireplace with wood stoves and sheds for wood storage, on 3,531 sq ft of land. The village has a mini market, cafes and tavernas. Asking €140,000, about €1,400/m².

homes.title: Renovated two-storey house, fully furnished, 50 m from the sea in Afissos, Magnesia
homes.title_es: Casa de dos plantas reformada, amueblada, a 50 m del mar en Afissos, Magnesia
homes.summary: Fully renovated two-storey house of 104 sq m, with a separate entrance for each floor. Each floor is self-contained, with one bedroom, a living room with kitchen, a bathroom and a veranda; the upper veranda has a barbecue. Sold fully furnished with new wooden furniture, it includes a refrigerator, two dishwashers, a washing machine, an electric cooker, a small electric oven and two extractor hoods. It has oil-fired central heating and 926 sq ft of land, 50 metres from the sea in central Afissos. Asking €180,000, about €1,731/m².

homes.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with a sea view in Pefki, North Evia
homes.title_es: Piso amueblado de dos dormitorios con vistas al mar en Pefki, norte de Eubea
homes.summary: A 50 m² first-floor flat a few hundred metres from the beach in Pefki, on the island of Evia, with a sea view from the balcony. Two bedrooms, a fitted kitchen, a modern shower room and a dining corner, all freshly finished with light floors. Electric heating, air conditioning, a security door and parking. Sold fully furnished and equipped, ready to use. Energy rating E. Asking €80,000, about €1,600/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated 1-bedroom stone house with garden and mountain views in Skripero, Corfu
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra totalmente renovada de 1 dormitorio con jardín y vistas a la montaña en Skripero, Corfú
homes.summary: This fully renovated detached house was rebuilt from a traditional stone house in 2025. It has one main bedroom with a fireplace, a guest or children's room, an open-plan kitchen, living and dining area, and two bathrooms with walk-in showers. Outdoor features include a large rear garden with lawn, a paved front courtyard with covered BBQ area, a 634.11 sq m plot and open mountain views. It has air conditioning, double glazing and a new roof. The airport is 18 km away and Corfu Town is 17 km away. Asking €129,000, about €1,612/m².

homes.title: Modern, furnished two-bedroom house near the sea on Rhodes
homes.title_es: Casa moderna y amueblada de dos dormitorios cerca del mar en Rodas
homes.summary: An 84 m² detached house in Paradeisi on Rhodes, in very good condition, modern, bright and sold furnished: a stylish kitchen with a breakfast bar and pendant lights, a living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Air conditioning, a solar water heater, aluminium frames and tiled floors, with no shared expenses. Close to the sea, shops, cafés and the island's airport. Asking €155,000, about €1,845/m².

homes.title: Furnished townhouse with shared pools and sea views in Makrigialos, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa adosada amueblada con piscinas comunitarias y vistas al mar en Makrigialos, Creta
homes.summary: This furnished townhouse offers 75 m2 of living space across two bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and two bathrooms. The fully fitted kitchen includes an oven, fridge and dishwasher, and an open plan living area leads through large patio doors to a balcony. From the balcony there are views of the pool, mountains and sea. The property sits in a complex with two large shared pools, a cafe and reception, plus an onsite management team. Air conditioning, cupboards and a parking space are included. Asking €165,000, about €2,200/m².

homes.title: Stone-built three-bedroom house with gulf views in Ano Volos, at the foot of Pelion
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de tres dormitorios con vistas al golfo en Ano Volos, al pie del Pelion
homes.summary: A stone-faced house built in 2004 in Agios Georgios, an old quarter of Ano Volos on the road up to Portaria. 114 m² on three levels with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, two kitchens and a living room with a fireplace. A veranda and a small garden face west over Volos and the Pagasetic Gulf. Oil central heating with radiators, new air conditioning units, a solar water heater, a storage room and private parking. Sold partly furnished. The advert puts the Volos waterfront 6.5 km away and Anavros beach 6 km away. Asking €167,000, about €1,465/m².

homes.title: Restored 1881 stone mansion with castle views in Volissos, Chios
homes.title_es: Mansión de piedra de 1881 restaurada con vistas al castillo en Volissos, Quíos
homes.summary: A stone house from 1881 in Volissos, in the north-west of Chios, once the village courthouse and later its school. Fully restored in 1998 and upgraded again in 2015: insulation, double glazing, a new tiled roof, solar hot water, renewed wiring and plumbing. 129 m² on two floors plus an attic bedroom under exposed beams, with two kitchens with marble worktops, two fireplaces and two bathrooms. The upper balcony looks over the village to the Genoese castle. The ground floor can work as a separate studio for guests. Asking €175,000, about €1,360/m².

homes.title: Renovated two-storey house with garden and fireplace in Longos, Peloponnese
homes.title_es: Casa de dos plantas renovada con jardín y chimenea en Longos, Peloponeso
homes.summary: Built in 1991 and fully renovated in 2022, this two-storey house offers 140 square metres of living space. The ground floor has a living room with a fireplace, a dining area, a kitchen and one bedroom, and the upper floor has two more bedrooms. Outdoor space includes a garden, verandas and a BBQ area, and the home has oil-fired heating, air conditioning and a solar water heater. It sits in a quiet neighbourhood near the Old and New National Roads. Asking €190,000, about €1,357/m².

homes.title: Detached 3-bedroom house with garden and mountain views in Zachloritika, Achaea
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 3 dormitorios con jardín y vistas a la montaña en Zachloritika, Achaea
homes.summary: Built in 2016, this detached house spans three levels with 132 m2 of living space, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. It sits on a plot of about 300 m2 with a garden and a private parking space. Features include a fireplace, air conditioning, solar water heating and electric heating, and the windows look out over the mountains. The beach is 2.5 km away and Patras is 49 km away. Asking €205,000, about €1,553/m².

homes.title: In good condition 2-bedroom house with open-plan living room in Eretria, Euboea
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios en buen estado con cocina y salón abierto en Eretria, Eubea
homes.summary: This house, built in 1998, is in good condition and sits on the ground floor. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and an open-plan kitchen and living room in 88 m2 of living space. The structure and exterior are in good structural condition. Heating is oil-fired central heating, and the energy rating is B. It is located in Eretria, Euboea, Central Greece. Asking €108,000, about €1,227/m².

homes.title: House in good condition with fireplace and garden in Foniskaria, Achaea, Western Greece
homes.title_es: Casa en buen estado con chimenea y jardín en Foniskaria, Acaya, Grecia Occidental
homes.summary: This house in good condition was built in 1960 and offers 82 square metres of living space. It has one bedroom, one bathroom, a living room with a fireplace and an open plan kitchen. The plot of 4,087.87 square metres includes 150 olive trees, 100 lemon trees, warehouses, chicken coops and a tank, plus a garden and two parking spaces. The home has oil-fired central heating and air conditioning. Asking €125,000, about €1,524/m².

homes.title: Ground-floor 2-bedroom house with views and stove heating in Milies, Pelion, Magnesia
homes.title_es: Casa de planta baja de 2 dormitorios con vistas y calefacción de leña en Milies, Pelion, Magnesia
homes.summary: Built in 1997 and in good condition, this ground-floor detached house has 61 sq m of living space. It has two bedrooms, one bathroom, a kitchen and a living room, with wooden window frames, tiled floors and stove heating. The 170 sq m plot is street-front and airy, with beautiful views, and is close to a school and a church. Access is via a traditional paved road, and beaches with turquoise waters are nearby. Asking €125,000, about €2,049/m².

homes.title: Brand-new 2025 cottage with a pergola deck 400 m from the sea in Halkidiki
homes.title_es: Casita nueva de 2025 con porche de pérgola a 400 m del mar en Calcídica
homes.summary: A new-build 72 m² house from 2025 in Kallikrateia, Halkidiki, energy class A and sold furnished: three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and three bathrooms, with a big wooden pergola deck, string lights for summer evenings, a garden with banana plants, parking, A/C, double glazing and a BBQ. The sea is 400 m away and Thessaloniki airport about 45 km. Asking €159,990, about €2,222/m².

homes.title: Restored three-bed stone house with roof terrace in Kritsa village, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de tres dormitorios restaurada con terraza en la azotea en el pueblo de Kritsa, Creta
homes.summary: A restored stone house a short walk from the square of Kritsa, the largest village around Agios Nikolaos and 7 km from the town and sandy beaches. A plant-filled terrace under a pergola leads to a furnished roof terrace with views over the mountains, the village and the sea in the distance. Inside are wood-beamed ceilings, stone walls, a living room with a wood stove, a fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and three bathrooms. It is sold furnished and in very good condition. Car access is about 70 m away, with public parking 100 to 150 m away.

homes.title: Wooden island-style house with a BBQ terrace hanging over the Pagasetic Gulf
homes.title_es: Casa de madera estilo isla con terraza y barbacoa sobre el golfo Pagasético
homes.summary: In the cobbled, island-like village of Trikeri at the tip of Pelion, a 54 m² house on two levels: a carefully renovated wooden studio with a high ceiling, a loft with a double bed, kitchen, dining area and bathroom, opening onto a big covered terrace with a wood oven, a BBQ and a fantastic view of the sea. Below, a separate 15 m² studio with its own kitchen and shower. Sleeps six; use it as one house or two holiday flats. Asking €120,000, about €2,222/m².

homes.title: Detached 2-bedroom house with garden and verandas in Kotronas, Mani, Peloponnese
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de 2 dormitorios con jardín y porches cubiertos en Kotronas, Mani, Peloponeso
homes.summary: This detached ground floor house, built in 2000, is sunny and airy and connected to mains water and electricity. It has a living room, a kitchen with a fireplace, two double bedrooms with cupboards and two bathrooms. A garden, covered verandas front and back, a 15 sq m storeroom and a 400 sq m plot come with it, plus one parking space. The sandy beach is 950 m away, and the village has small shops and restaurants. Gytheio is 31 km away and Areopolis is a 20 minute drive. Asking €145,000, about €1,611/m².

homes.title: Two-storey stone house facing the Libyan Sea in Koutsounari, south Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de dos plantas con vista al mar de Libia en Koutsounari, sur de Creta
homes.summary: A two-storey stone house with open views of the Libyan Sea, 1.3 km from Long Beach on the south coast of Crete. A stone-paved courtyard under a pergola faces the sea, and inside stairs lead up to a large view terrace. The living room has wood beams and a fireplace, and there is a separate traditional kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, all tiled. Hot water comes from a solar panel, and there is parking outside. Shops and tavernas open all year are a 3-minute drive away. About 88 m2 for 195,000 euros.

homes.title: Summer cottage on a 980 m² garden plot 2 km from the beach
homes.title_es: Casita de verano en una parcela de 980 m² a 2 km de la playa
homes.summary: A 62 m² house on a flat plot of 980 m² among olive trees and just a few neighbours, near Marathopolis: a sitting area with a wood stove, an open kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room downstairs, and a wooden staircase up to an attic with a balcony and extra beds. A garden with paths, a storeroom and a built-in BBQ. 2 km to Lagouvardos beach, 15 minutes to Gialova and its golf courses, 25 to Pylos. Asking €158,000, about €2,548/m².

homes.title: Renovated traditional 2-bedroom house with garden and village views in Pitsidia, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional reformada de 2 dormitorios con jardín y vistas al pueblo en Pitsidia, Creta
homes.summary: Renovated traditional house on two levels with 73 m2 of living space, 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The ground floor has an open-plan equipped kitchen-dining room with a wood stove, and the upper floor holds both bedrooms, with village views. The fenced courtyard offers privacy and includes a terrace and a separate storage room. The main square, cafes and shops are within walking distance, and the beach is a few minutes away. Sold fully furnished and ready to move in. Asking €189,000, about €2,589/m².

homes.title: Restored stone courtyard house with a sea-view roof terrace in Gytheio
homes.title_es: Casa de patio de piedra restaurada con terraza con vistas al mar en Gytheio
homes.summary: A traditional stone house of 85 m2 on a quiet car-free lane in the old town of Gytheio, a short walk from the harbour front, on a 127 m2 walled plot. Restored with original stone paving, wooden floors and old doors kept. A stone-floored living room opens to the courtyard, where a newly renovated kitchen and an outdoor shower sit under a lemon tree. Upstairs are a double and a single bedroom and a modern shower room, and a raised terrace looks over the rooftops to the sea. Sold turnkey; Mavrovouni beach is 5 minutes by car.

homes.title: Renovated 1-bedroom detached house with garden and terrace in Volos, Magnesia
homes.title_es: Casa independiente reformada con jardín y terraza en Volos, Magnesia
homes.summary: Fully renovated detached house of 77 sq m on a 121 sq m plot in Agios Konstantinos. It has an entrance hall, separate kitchen, dining room, living room, one bedroom and one bathroom, plus a 20 sq m basement. A private courtyard surrounds the property, and the home has an individual natural gas boiler, inverter air conditioning and a security alarm system. It is close to the city centre and the seafront. Asking €195,000, about €2,532/m².

homes.title: Two-level semi-detached villa with shared pool and mountain views in Asproulianos, Crete
homes.title_es: Villa adosada de dos plantas con piscina compartida y vistas a la montaña en Asproulianos, Creta
homes.summary: This two-level semi-detached villa has 66 m2 of living space, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a guest WC. Underfloor heating runs throughout, and the living room has a wood burner. A covered tiled terrace on the upper level overlooks the shared pool and has distant sea views, while the property also has a small garden and private covered parking. Georgioupolis sandy beach is 3 to 5 minutes away, and Chania airport is about 45 minutes' drive. Asking €185,000, about €2,803/m².

homes.title: Traditional 2-bedroom stone house with terrace and mountain views in Melampes, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional de piedra de 2 dormitorios con terraza y vistas a la montaña en Melampes, Creta
homes.summary: The two-story stone house has 100 m² of living space and is in good structural condition, with the structure and exterior also in good condition. The ground floor holds two bedrooms with air conditioning and a bathroom, while upstairs there is a fully equipped kitchen-living room and a second bathroom. A terrace and balconies overlook the mountains. A laundry room and cupboards complete the layout. Asking €190,000, about €1,900/m².

homes.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with sea views in Nea Fokea, Kassandra, Halkidiki
homes.title_es: Piso de dos dormitorios amueblado con vistas al mar en Nea Fokea, Kassandra, Halkidiki
homes.summary: A 60 m2 first-floor flat in a two-storey building in Nea Fokea, a seaside village on the Kassandra peninsula of Halkidiki. The advert says the sea can be seen from the windows and that the owners will leave the furniture. Open living room with a modern fitted kitchen and wood stove, two bedrooms and a shower room, with windows on two sides and a covered balcony with awnings. Air conditioning, oil central heating with radiators and solar water heating. The photos show a well-kept home ready to use.

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with elevated terrace and sea views in Tsikalaria, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 2 dormitorios con terraza elevada y vistas al mar en Tsikalaria, Creta
homes.summary: The house was completely renovated and reconstructed to high standards, with renewed electrical and plumbing installations. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, an open-plan kitchen and living room, a balcony and an elevated terrace with sea views. Climate control comes from air-conditioning units and electric heating, and there is a solar water heater. It sits about 3 km from Souda Port and about 6 km from the centre of Chania, with Chania airport about 17 km away. Asking €185,000, about €2,984/m².

homes.title: Furnished one-bedroom ground-floor flat with a private yard in Elounda, Crete
homes.title_es: Apartamento de planta baja amueblado de un dormitorio con patio privado en Elounda, Creta
homes.summary: A ground-floor flat of 35.5 m² in Elounda, one of the best-known resort towns in Crete, sold fully furnished and ready to use. An open kitchen and living room with air conditioning opens onto a front balcony, and the double bedroom gives straight onto a private walled yard with a tree and a seating area. Modern shower room, solar panels for hot water and a 20 m² basement storage room. The advert puts Agios Nikolaos under 10 minutes away by car and Heraklion airport about an hour away. Asking €125,000, a low entry price for Elounda.

homes.title: Furnished 2-bedroom sea view apartment with fireplace in Perdika, Aegina
homes.title_es: Apartamento amueblado de 2 dormitorios con vistas al mar y chimenea en Perdika, Egina
homes.summary: First-floor apartment of 75 m2 built in 2009, in excellent condition and fully furnished. It has two bedrooms, one bathroom, a living room with fireplace, a dining room and an open plan kitchen, plus large balconies with sea views. Heating is autonomous oil-fired, and the apartment has air conditioning and double glazed windows. A supermarket and a bakery are 150 metres away, and the beach and Perdika port with restaurants and cafes are within walking distance. Asking €210,000, about €2,800/m².

homes.title: Renovated furnished 2-bedroom ground-floor flat with air conditioning in Dryopida, Kea-Kythnos
homes.title_es: Piso reformado y amueblado de 2 dormitorios con aire acondicionado en Dryopida, Kea-Kythnos
homes.summary: Built in 1995 and renovated in 2021, this fully furnished ground-floor flat has 65 m2 of living space, two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and two bathrooms. It has a small semi-outdoor space, electric heating and air conditioning. Aluminum frames with double glazing and screens, and a wooden floor, complete the interior. The flat is quiet, allows pets and lies up to 200 m from the square, the market and the cobbled pedestrian street, with a supermarket 100 m away. Asking €180,000, about €2,769/m².
